question: Approve this A5 rework design and its acceptance criteria into implementation? Approving also adds to Scope 'each row's Remove text button becomes a ✕ icon button (direction A5)' and accepts the new AC-3 for it; say if you object.

artifacts.summary: A5 rework ideation: one field pill per row (ITEM › field), Browse row removed, vault read on first pill press, ≠ mark with its own detail line, Remove becomes ✕ (routed here by FO). 23 whole-page previews at 1280 and 400 px in design/shots/. Design review ideation-3: 15 MINOR findings, all declined with reasons (third run, over the two-run cap, because the follow-up replaced the reviewed design).
